senses.zh_definition: 【英语词义】磨坊或谷物加工厂的业主、经营者或操作人员，尤指将谷物磨成面粉的人。
senses.en_definition: An English noun for a person who owns or operates a mill, especially one that grinds grain into flour.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada pemilik atau pengendali kilang, khususnya kilang yang mengisar bijirin menjadi tepung; padanan bagi pemilik ialah pekilang, manakala padanan bagi pengendali ialah pengilang.
senses.nuances: 本义依据 DBP 英马词典释写，并非已核实的马来语单语词条释义。下列搭配采用马来语对应表达。若原文为姓氏 Miller，应保留姓名，不译为职业。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pengilang)

etymology.historical_story: English miller names an occupation associated with turning grain into flour. Merriam-Webster dates its first known use to the fourteenth century. The occupational noun and the capitalized surname Miller must be distinguished when reading Malay texts: an English name appearing in a Malay sentence does not establish a Malay common noun. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/miller)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 mill（磨坊）联想 miller（磨坊经营者）；遇到大写 Miller，先检查是否为姓氏。
